supersedes: raw centre-difference slope + global top (Stage005 first pass)

definitions.wheel_patch: 9x9 cells at 4 mm around the wheel's own target point
definitions.flat_area_frac: fraction of finite patch cells with |z - patch_median| <= 0.01
definitions.slope: magnitude of the least-squares plane gradient over finite patch cells
definitions.support_gap: any NaN cell on the segment edge_x..target_x within +/-1 cell of the wheel line
definitions.z_reference: patch_median, not the global rock top

note: Old raw-difference results are kept; this revision is registered before any CLIMB run with per-wheel landings.
